pins.head: SKIP THE SECOND JAR
pins.sub: A Refill Pouch Beside the Jar
pins.title: Moisturizer Refills: Buy the Pouch, Not Another Jar
pins.desc: The glass jar on the counter is the part worth keeping. A refill pouch of the same formula usually costs less per ounce than a new jar, and it takes a fraction of the shelf space to store. Wash and dry the jar before you top it up, and note the date so the next pouch arrives before the jar runs dry. Contains affiliate links. #SkincareRoutine #RefillRoutine #BathroomCounter
pins.alt: An open glass jar of white moisturizer with its lid resting beside it and a cream refill pouch standing behind on a bright white bathroom counter, with folded white towels on the ledge behind, under the headline Skip the Second Jar.

pins.head: THE SCRAPER COMES FIRST
pins.title: Cutting Mats: Clear the Scraps With a Scraper Between Cuts
pins.desc: Offcuts left on the mat are what dull the next cut. Push a plastic scraper across the surface at a low angle to lift the scraps and the glue stays where it belongs, then save the water and soap for when the tack is genuinely gone. Keep one mat for paper and another for vinyl so the fibers never mix. Contains affiliate links. #CuttingMat #VinylCrafts #CraftOrganization
pins.alt: A cream plastic scraper and a wooden-handled lint roller resting on a stack of lavender, blue-grey and green cutting mats on a whitewashed table, with small vinyl offcuts around them.

pins.head: BEND THE MOLD, NOT THE DISC
pins.title: Flexible Round Silicone Molds for Clean Resin Release
pins.desc: A cured disc comes out when the mold bends, not when you lever it with something hard. Soft silicone lets you push from underneath and walk the edge loose, which keeps the face of the piece unscratched. Work over a mat so the drips land somewhere you can wipe instead of on the bench. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #SiliconeMolds #EpoxyResin
pins.alt: A hand lifting a cured amber resin disc out of a round silicone mould over a large dark silicone work mat, with a second mould holding another amber disc beside it.

pins.head: STICK EACH ONE ON A CORK
pins.title: Miniature Priming: Mount Them on Corks Before You Spray
pins.desc: A figure held between two fingers gets primer on the fingers and a bare patch on the model. Stick each one to a cork first and you can turn it under the spray without touching it, and set it down to dry without laying it on a wet side. Work in thin passes and let the coat dry before the first color goes on. Contains affiliate links. #MiniaturePainting #Warhammer #PaintingTips
pins.alt: Grey primed miniatures standing on numbered corks on a green cutting mat beside a plain spray can, brushes in a stoneware cup and a wet palette, under the headline Stick Each One on a Cork.

pins.head: THE BACK PANEL DOES THE MATH
pins.title: Supplement Labels: Serving Size Decides What a Bottle Really Costs
pins.desc: A bottle with more capsules is not the better buy if a serving is three of them. Copy the serving size and the servings per container onto a notepad, divide the price by the servings, and compare that number instead of the shelf price. The same line tells you how long the bottle actually lasts. Contains affiliate links. #SupplementFacts #LabelReading #HouseholdEssentials
pins.alt: Three amber supplement bottles on a pale counter beside an open notepad with a pencil resting on it and a tall glass of water.

pins.head: THREE NUMBERS BEFORE YOU BUY
pins.title: Under-Sink Organizer Size: Measure Depth and Pipe Clearance
pins.desc: Three numbers decide whether an organizer fits: the width wall to wall, the depth from the door frame back, and how far the drain pipe sits from each side. Run the tape along the cabinet floor for all three and write them down before you shop. A rack an inch too deep will not let the door close. Contains affiliate links. #UnderSinkStorage #KitchenOrganization #SmallKitchen
pins.alt: A yellow tape measure stretched across the floor of an open under-sink cabinet from wall to wall, with the base of a white drain pipe and the edge of a sage rack at the side.
